resources.string: Lightweight filter based on a domain list (OISD Small), updated automatically when the app starts (at most once every 7 days). It does not block Stream8, TMDB, first-party requests or main-frame navigation. It does not guarantee complete ad blocking. The change applies to subsequent requests: reload the page to apply it fully.
Paste the Stream8 settings sharing link.
If you have a settings sharing link, paste it here. Otherwise continue without importing. This message appears only on first launch.

Stream8 for Android is a WebView wrapper for Stream8 (stream8.poppi.cc): both projects are by the same author. It is not affiliated with TMDB or the linked streaming services.

• No telemetry, no ads, no access to local files, camera, microphone or location. Cookies and browsing data stay on the device.

• Start from Stream8 (stream8.poppi.cc).

• When you tap a service on Stream8, the page opens inside the app and the authorized domain becomes the service domain, including all its subdomains.

• Without TMDB in the chain, the service cannot open other domains or Stream8: use the Back button to return.

• TMDB (themoviedb.org) is always reachable. When the chain goes through TMDB, services can open new domains with a real tap or through server redirects (e.g. TMDB → JustWatch → Prime Video).

• From Stream8, TMDB and services in the TMDB cascade, a link can open the compatible Android app (e.g. an installed streaming app) with a real tap. A service opened directly from Stream8, without TMDB, cannot launch apps; redirects and automatic navigations never open apps.

• HTTPS only. Invalid certificates are never accepted. No external browser is opened.
